fusions.name: Barge Into
fusions.desc: Drifts the whole weight of your ride into a target up to 6 tiles away. It deals 26 damage, up to 1.5 times that at the far end of its reach, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and slows the target by 30% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lazy Wake
fusions.desc: Drifts a heavy wake over every enemy within 3 tiles. It deals 6 damage, with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 4 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Becalmed
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Water Living
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 15. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
